title: .claude/odyssey.json
description: What the Odyssey kit runs or matches on in this repo. Only version is required; every other key has a default.

srcDirs.description: Source directories, relative to the repo root. Default: ["src"].

testDirs.description: Test directories, relative to the repo root. Default: ["test"].

gate.description: The local gate /odyssey:local-gate runs: the same stages CI runs.

stages.description: Each stage runs on its own and reports pass or fail.

fix.description: The auto-fix commands local-gate's fix mode runs before the stages.

db.description: The migration flow /odyssey:db-migration drives. Without it, the repo has no migration flow.

schemaFile.description: The schema file migrations are generated from.

seedFile.description: The seed, which must stay idempotent.

generate.description: Generates a migration from the schema.

migrate.description: Applies pending migrations to a local database.

plan.description: The plan /odyssey:make-a-path and /odyssey:what-next read beside docs/plans/.

check.description: The repo's own docs check, which the gate's docs stage runs after the kit's, such as "npm run docs:check".

roadmap.description: Retired: no longer read. Kept so a config written before it went stays valid.

deploy.description: Retired: no longer read. Kept so a config written before it went stays valid.

deployManifest.description: Retired: no longer read. Kept so a config written before it went stays valid.

always.description: Retired: no longer read. Kept so a config written before it went stays valid.

metaSync.description: Retired: no longer read. Kept so a config written before it went stays valid.

appendOnly.description: File names Claude may only append to, such as a session journal. Needs hooks.protectAppendOnly.

readOnly.description: File names only a human edits, such as an audit log. Every Claude session is blocked from them. Needs hooks.protectAppendOnly.

secrets.description: Extra secret-file patterns, added to the secrets guard's defaults, which stay in force. Without a slash a pattern matches a file name, with one the end of the path; * matches within one name, **/ any number of folders, and letter case is ignored. Names ending .example, .sample, .template, .dist or .pub stay writable. For example ".npmrc" or "config/*.local.yaml".

manifests.description: Extra dependency manifests, such as pyproject.toml or Cargo.toml, added to package.json and the npm, yarn and pnpm lockfiles. Needs hooks.protectManifest.

layer2Owned.description: Retired: no longer read. Kept so a config written before it went stays valid.

reviewers.description: Retired: no longer read. Kept so a config written before it went stays valid.

hooks.description: The hooks' switches. The opt-in hooks are off by default; the secrets guard, the stamped-file guard and the zsh guard are always on, and the commit gate is on whenever gate.stages is set.

protectManifest.description: Block hand edits to dependency manifests and lockfiles.

loadLog.description: Log each instruction file Claude Code loads, one line each under ~/.claude/odyssey-loads/, which the docs check and /odyssey:audit set beside the files that should load.

formatOnEdit.description: Format each edited file with the repo's own Prettier, and lint-fix it with ESLint under srcDirs and testDirs. Runs only after you trust it.

esmImportExtension.description: Flag relative imports without a .js extension in TypeScript under srcDirs and testDirs.

commitGate.description: Run gate.stages and the docs stage before each git commit Claude runs, and block the commit when a stage fails. On whenever gate.stages is set; false turns it off. Runs only after you trust the stage commands.

typecheckGate.description: When Claude stops while the working tree holds uncommitted TypeScript changes under srcDirs or testDirs, run command; errors send Claude back to fix them. Runs only after you trust the command.

timeoutSec.description: The gate's own time limit. Default: 300.
